content: The official 24/7 league is currently bifurcated between active execution and dormant carry positions. Timmy Top 50 remains the only strategy generating live order flow through June 13, validating a low-win-rate/high-win-size phenotype with near-breakeven realized performance and disciplined open-risk control. Timmy Top 20 continues trading as a live negative control, bleeding consistent realized losses that isolate pair-breadth sensitivity. Both Cosmo & Wanda variants have been inactive since June 8–9, with open unrealized losses eroding 55–80% of previously realized gains and reducing their effective role to unmanaged portfolios. The immediate priority is distinguishing stalled infrastructure from broken edge, while using the active Timmy A/B pair to resolve whether broader coverage improves opportunity or merely dilutes noise.
